messages.content: I'm taking a ₹45 lakh home loan at 8.6% for 20 years. What will my EMI be, and how much interest will I pay in total?

graders.description: Open coding before the rubric: overall verdict plus a note.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.

judge_criteria_to_write: Clarity: does the answer lead with the EMI? Does it put Rs 49.4 lakh of interest in plain terms?
